verdict.rationale: LM Studio's Bionic feature explicitly claims real-time speech transcription during natural conversation, and since Bionic runs alongside local models this is presented as an on-device capability. However this is a single first-party marketing line with no technical detail on the STT model used, no independent/community hands-on confirmation of speech transcription performance, and no docs coverage in the main app/CLI docs. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of transcription quality/latency, technical documentation of the on-device STT model, and confirmation it works fully offline without cloud fallback.
